aboutMe.paragraph: I am a full-stack developer with more than 7 years developing 💻 websites with modern platforms and programming languages. I like to learn things, build things, fix things 🔧 with a keen eye to design and purpose.

Going into Development was, in a sense, a career change, because that was not my full time job, but, at the same time, building things with code has been a constant throughout my life. From that perspective, I just decided to finally do something I really enjoy and something I am passionate about.

experience.summary: Frontend and cloud-based solutions: building and optimising high-performance applications in a cloud environment.
highlights: Build dynamic, responsive web applications with Next.js, React, Redux and JavaScript libraries.
Develop and manage APIs with API Management, handling data as JSON.
Code review, debugging and refactoring for performance and maintainability.
Cloud delivery on Microsoft Azure and Azure DevOps with CI pipelines; monitoring and logging with Kibana; asset bundling with Webpack.
Prototype and implement interfaces together with design teams in Figma.

experience.summary: Scalable software for an international company serving thousands of users worldwide.
highlights: Designed responsive, maintainable front ends with JavaScript, TypeScript, React and Redux.
Built and debugged APIs using API Management, JSON, Elasticsearch, Kibana and Postman.
Set up CI pipelines on Microsoft Azure and Azure DevOps.
Delivered within agile cycles using the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).

experience.summary: Management, operations and strategic support, with international assignments in Slovakia, the Netherlands and Algeria. Vice-Consul in the Netherlands (2011–2013).
highlights: Led budgeting, procurement and contract management.
Managed legacy IT infrastructure with technical teams.
Key liaison in the rollout of a global eLearning platform.
Ran data research, analysis and reporting on economic, political and cultural trends.

experience.summary: Research and teaching in translation studies, linguistics and critical analysis.
highlights: Taught technical translation (technology, economics, business) and literary translation.
Taught critical reading, text analysis and speech interpretation.
Supervised final-year research projects and theses.
